summary: Steep parked-on kerb below a leafy bank; flats 15 m away.
reasons: Cars park here in QLD image

drivers.seclusion: Westbury flats 15 m and North View 16 m on the same side, screened by dense trees; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Parking lane where cars sit in the QLD image; one car on the lane in Esri; room for a van at the start.
drivers.traffic: Residential through street; the stretch ends at a junction with a give-way line.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs; no council signs on this stretch.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy on the south side shades much of the kerb, mainly from the south and west.

best_section.where: south kerb of Waverley Road at the eastern end, beside the hedge and bank
